notes.title: Hotfix Report #1
notes.content:
Greetings,

This week, we've identified a number of issues that interfere playing, details are given below.

And, feel free to contact us at vlt2011game@gmail.com if you have some problems or suggestions.

Thank you.

[b]Patch Notes[/b]

ㆍAdded a turn key option for those who are limited rear recognition when using the Oculus Rift. Manipulate joystick to turn!
